category_title: Students who use avoidance strategies like pretended reading during silent reading
minimal_context: The student is expected to read independently and quietly from a book during a silent reading session after the lunch break.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our silent reading session. Please open your books and read independently and quietly.

STUDENT: (Whispers in a low voice to a classmate in the corner and keeps turning the pages without stopping to read.)

TUTOR: Please make sure you are looking at your book.

STUDENT: (Swaps books with the classmate, opening a text that has many words and no illustrations.)

TUTOR: Are you reading your new book now?

STUDENT: I'm just going to kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don't actually read it.

options.A: Provide immediate instructional feedback, explaining exactly what the student should have done.
options.B: Respond to the request and allow the student to read with the classmate.
options.C: Describe the inappropriate behavior in objective terms, noting the events that led to it.
options.D: Place a hand on the student's shoulder during the silent reading session.
